name: 拉丽萨·坎波斯
name_full: 拉丽萨·坎波斯 Larissa Campos
introduction: Larissa Campos is a Brazilian-American actress, singer and dancer. Larissa had studied at various prestigious schools and studios in Canada, New York, LA and Atlanta. Larissa is known for her most recent films, Recall (2024), Zero (2025), Bacon Cheese Burger and Chocolate Milkshake (2025), The Deadman's Playground (2024) and many more.
